resources.string: Group versions of the same channel
Show one row per channel in each list. Up/down switches between logical channels.
Priority of versions of the same channel
Full HD → HEVC → HD → normal → Low. Hold OK on a channel to set a manual order. Hidden versions are excluded.
Priority enabled. Manual order overrides the automatic order for this group.
Priority disabled. Order edits are saved; enable priority in Settings to apply them.
Hidden · excluded from priority and automatic alternatives
